title: Remake Charges, Rebuild Leads and Partial Shipment — Factory Production Orders Class Schedule
content:
Units of Factory Production Orders that must be rebuilt are remade on their order. The class schedule below sets the remake figures.

| Build class | Charge per unit remade for a customer specification error (USD) | Rebuild lead from the remake date (business days) | Passed units may ship ahead of units being remade | Smallest share of units passed for a partial shipment |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Custom Size Build | 189.00 | 10 | Yes | 0.75 |
| Custom Color Build | 229.00 | 15 | Yes | 0.75 |
| Specialty Glass Build | 264.00 | 15 | Yes | 0.75 |
| Specialty Shape Build | 312.00 | 20 | Yes | 0.75 |
| Impact-Rated Build | 418.00 | 25 | No | 0 |
| Architectural Wood Build | 486.00 | 30 | No | 0 |

Business days are Monday through Friday, excluding U.S. federal holidays. Where partial shipment is not allowed, the share reads 0.

## Settings common to every class

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| Remakes caused by a factory defect, freight damage or a Ridgeline mismeasure carry no customer charge | Yes |
| A remake may be charged as a customer specification error only when the customer signed the acknowledgment showing the specification | Yes |
| Remakes one order may receive before a further remake is escalated to factory engineering | 2 |
| Units failing the factory quality check are remade as factory defects rather than repaired | Yes |

## Points of reading

- A share of 0.75 means at least three quarters of the order's units must have passed quality check for passed units to ship ahead. Hypothetical example: on a 12-unit Custom Color Build order, 9 passed units meet the share and 8 do not.
- The Impact-Rated Build and Architectural Wood Build classes ship each order whole.
